Question: A 33-year-old female with bipolar disorder, well controlled with lithium, presents to your clinic. She would like to discuss pregnancy and her medication. She is worried that her folate levels might be low despite taking multivitamins every day. She would like to know if she needs to wait before becoming pregnant. opa. Discontinue the lithium
opb. Switch to lamotrigine for the 1st trimester
opc. The fetus will be at risk for neural tube defects
opd. She can be maintained on valproate instead
ope. Electroconvulsive therapy is unsafe during pregnancy
